_note: What You Can Promise Alone: bare previs of the scholars' coast libraries (set 'libraries'). No cast: the image pass adds the people; each note is the picture's brief.

cover.note: A library on the coast with its door open: a librarian stands in the doorway handing a reader a scroll from the shelves behind, while down the road a courier sits on a wall with his bundle, stopped, in no hurry.

p01-door.note: A reader at the library door asking for a work; the librarian answers from the shelves inside. A courier's bundle lies at the roadside, the road empty beyond.

p02-porch.note: The library's porch in the afternoon: a reader sits on the porch step reading, his own corrections on a tablet beside him.

p03-path.note: The library seen across a path: a reader walks away along it with a scroll, and returns to the same door.

p04-roof.note: A second library further along the coast, its road to the first blocked by a stopped courier; a reader at its door is told the work is not on its shelves.
